responsibility: This header defines the parser’s compilation-state model and state-stack records used while building Fortran program-unit and block structure. It enumerates parser states for procedures, modules, blocks, control constructs, OpenMP/OpenACC structured regions, and provides the state data structure, convenience macros, and key parser-support declarations shared among parsing and matching code.
same_name_distinction: Defines the parser-facing state model and interface: the gfc_compile_state enum, gfc_state_data stack record, access macros, and parser-support prototypes. Unlike gcc/fortran/parse.cc, it does not perform statement decoding or drive whole-unit parsing; it provides the shared types and declarations that parsing code uses.
